channel.title: Pysano Updates
channel.description: Stable and beta updates for Pysano.

item.title: 0.8.0-beta.15
item.description:
# Pysano 0.8.0 Beta 15
- Keeps the local recorder running when the Gemini Live connection fails, preserving the complete dictation until the user stops recording. - Sends stopped and recovered recordings through standard transcription instead of replaying the entire recording to Gemini Live in real time on every retry. - Uses Gemini Files API for longer WAV recordings, then deletes the temporary remote file after transcription. Google also expires uploaded files automatically after 48 hours if immediate cleanup cannot complete. - Adds bounded request timeouts so a stalled upload or transcription attempt can fail visibly and retry instead of waiting forever. - Adds automated coverage for long-recording uploads, remote cleanup, processing failures, retry classification, and transcription request construction. - Selects an installed Swift SDK that is compatible with the active Apple compiler when Command Line Tools ship a mismatched default SDK.

item.title: 0.8.0-beta.14
item.description:
# Pysano 0.8.0 Beta 14
- Preserves the latest completed or interrupted dictation in a private local recovery file until transcription succeeds or the user explicitly discards it. - Restores a pending recording after relaunch and keeps a recovered transcript available under Latest text. - Retries transient Gemini transcription failures automatically with bounded 1, 2, and 4 second backoff while avoiding blind retries for permanent errors. - Recovers usable audio after microphone, audio-route, sleep, session, or hotkey interruptions. - Reconnects incoming Live Translation after transient network, browser-process, audio-device, and detected silent-connection failures. - Restores active Live Translation channels after sleep or macOS session reactivation. - Adds automated coverage for recovery-file permissions, corrupt transcript isolation, retry classification, and reconnect classification.
Real microphone, sleep/wake, browser-video, and meeting-client acceptance remain required before publication.

item.title: 0.8.0-beta.10
item.description:
# Pysano 0.8.0 Beta 10
- Fixed the meeting microphone failing immediately as an unavailable device. The selected input now uses a direct Core Audio device connection and no longer depends on an unstable default-device aggregate created by AVAudioEngine. - Added an eight-second, local-only test for the selected microphone with a live level meter and a clear result. Test audio is neither saved nor sent to Gemini or the virtual output. - Replaced the fixed push-to-talk shortcut menu with a shortcut recorder. Press the desired combination, a function key, Right Option, or fn/Globe; conflicts with dictation and voice-command shortcuts are rejected. - Added the recommended toggle behavior: press the shortcut once to start speaking and again to finish. Hold-to-talk remains available as an option. - Fixed browser and meeting listening sessions stopping after a temporary Core Audio route rebuild. Playback now rebuilds itself, drops stale queued sound if necessary, and keeps reconnecting after transient browser, device, or network changes until the user stops listening. - Meeting translation now shows separately what Gemini heard from the microphone and what it translated for the call. - Device failures distinguish the physical microphone from the BlackHole virtual output.
Meeting voice translation remains experimental. The direct microphone route and translated output still require verification on actual devices and in a real call before claiming compatibility with every meeting client.

# Pysano 0.7.1
- The **Repair Key Access** action now rebuilds the legacy Keychain item's ACL once for Pysano's stable code signature, preventing an unlock prompt on every launch. - The API key remains in Keychain; there are no automatic system prompts and the key is never saved to project files. - Added four feedback sound sets: Liquid, Soft Chime, Pulse, and macOS System. - Liquid is the new default short cue. Every option can be previewed in Settings without starting a recording, and sound feedback can still be disabled completely.

# Pysano 0.7.0
- Made the dictation indicator smaller and moved its default position to the top so it does not cover the input field. - Added top, bottom, left, and right indicator placement options. - The completion message can be hidden or displayed for 0.5, 1, 2, or 4 seconds; the default is 1 second. - Added native macOS sounds at recording start and completion, with a separate sound toggle.

# Pysano 0.6.2
- Added a focused-node fallback for ChatGPT, Codex, and other Chromium/Electron/WebKit editors that expose `AXGroup` or `AXWebArea` instead of a standard text AX role. - Before insertion, Pysano revalidates the original app, window, and Accessibility node; password and secure containers remain blocked. - A missing Accessibility permission is no longer masked by an unknown text-field message. - After a failed attempt, the menu offers sanitized focus diagnostics that exclude field text, selection, keystrokes, and clipboard contents.
